brand.name: Land Rover
brand.tagline: British SUV maker, part of JLR (owned by Tata Motors since 2008)
brand.description: British maker of four-wheel-drive SUVs, founded in 1948 and part of JLR, which Tata Motors has owned since 2008. In India it is sold by Jaguar Land Rover India Limited under the Range Rover, Defender and Discovery families; several models are locally assembled, the rest are imported.

Specs from JLR India's online configurator. Dimensions and boot (818 l behind row 2) are for SWB; LWB is 5252 mm long on a 3197 mm wheelbase. Ground clearance is the standard air-suspension ride height (off-road height 291 mm). Seats: 5 standard, 7 on LWB Autobiography (7 Seats); a 4-seat SV layout, if offered in India, is not shown in the configurator data. No ARAI figure published. Range Rover Electric is open for bookings but unpriced, so it is not included.

models.notes: Prices from JLR India's official price list (26MY): made-in-India Defender 110, imported 130 and OCTA. One all-India ex-showroom price, used here for Delhi. Defender 90 is not on the current price list and is left out. Dimensions are for the 110 from Land Rover's UK technical sheet (5018 mm with spare wheel, 4758 mm without), because the Indian configurator gives none for the 110. Boot is 743 l behind row 2 (5+2 seats). Ground clearance is the 110's air-suspension ride height; OCTA is 250 mm. Seats: the Indian configurator lists the 130 with 5 seats by default, with 7-seat (captain chairs) and 8-seat layouts as options; check which are offered. No ARAI figure or airbag count published.
